Xiaomi 18 Pro Varian Global Nongol di Database SDPPI Indonesia — Siap Rilis di Tanah Air

The global launch date of the Xiaomi 18 Pro series is yet to be announced, but the brand has already confirmed that the two smartphones will be offered with the same chipsets as their Chinese counterparts . Now, the global model number of the Xiaomi 18 Pro has been spotted on Indonesia’s SDPPI database, pointing to its possible launch in the country. About the SDPPI appearance, the smartphone carrying the model number ‘2609BPN61G’ has been listed under the Xiaomi branding, with PT Xiaomi Technology Indonesia mentioned as the applicant. Its certification is dated the 12th of October 2026, and the certificate number ‘127564/DJID/2026’ has been provided. While no key specifications or features have been revealed via the database, this appearance suggests that the Xiaomi 18 Pro is being prepared for the Indonesian market. However, its exact launch date and availability details are yet to be officially revealed. Regarding the chipsets, Xiaomi had previously confirmed through a teaser that the standard Pro model will be powered by Qualcomm’s Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chip, whereas the Pro Max will be featuring the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6. These are the same chipsets offered on the respective Chinese models. Speaking more, only the Xiaomi 18 Pro has been confirmed for the Indian market so far, and rumours have pointed to a possible December 2026 launch in the country . However, an official confirmation regarding this timeline is still awaited. The brand is also yet to announce when the Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max will be unveiled globally. Following further updates, we’ll be able to confirm their launch timelines, pricing details, and more. Stay tuned until then.
